[LGRA.8.7] **A rule has at most 255 patterns**,
negated patterns included. The compiler **must** refuse a program in which any
rule has more, with `DS_VALIDATE_RULE_TOO_MANY_PATTERNS`. The limit binds every
rule the compiler builds as well, such as an `after` body's follow-up rule
([LTAC.3.5]). A pattern's index in the artefact is a byte, and 255 is reserved
([RDSC.4a.9.1]).
